{{Quote|Sir, we've lost our bridge deflector shields!|The officer at the Battle of Endor|<ref name="Episode 6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
A young [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|human]] serving as an '''[[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]]''' aboard the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] reported to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Piett]] when the vessel's shields were compromised, shortly before the vessel's bridge was destroyed by an [[A-wing]] piloted by [[Arvel Crynyd/Legends|Arvel Crynyd]].

==Behind the scenes==
This character was portrayed by [[Alan Flyng]], who was also responsible for several of the costumes for the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] crew.

According to the tabulation of [[Rank insignia plaque/Legends|Imperial Navy rank plaques]] seen in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', this officer may have held the line rank of either [[Senior Commander/Legends|Senior Commander]] or [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]].
